caseNameFull: Royal Insurance Co., Ltd. v. Eastham
attorneys: Messrs. Louis M. Denit and Leonard J. Oanse for petitioners. Mr. Niel P. Sterne for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of .Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
